GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descriptio: The Gu Hand stores up to 7 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, recovered Gu are drawn at random from the recovery pile. Killer Move deduction can use only Gu in this pile. An affordable Activate in your normal hand lets you play a Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Recovery Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descript: Stores cooling Gu and recovered Gu waiting because the Gu Hand is full. At turn start, vacancies are filled at random. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move using materials only from the Gu Hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.selectionP: Choose the next Gu Worm (material order does not matter). {SelectedCount} selected; after choosing at least one, confirm or go back to finish.
